channel.title: Hoover Sun LLC - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hoover Sun LLC (hooversun.com)

item.title: Telling yourself the truth: How writing became healing for Levi Stowe
item.description: Once a punishment, writing became Levi Stowe’s refuge. Through foster care and hardship, he found healing on the page, using honesty and satire to process pain and encourage others to begin their own stories.

item.title: Band students from Hoover schools picked for honor bands, shows
item.description: Hoover High senior Cameron Gordon was selected for the Bands of America Honor Band in the 2026 Rose Parade, highlighting a standout year of statewide and national honors for Hoover school musicians.

item.title: Celebrate Alabama’s quilting tradition with ‘Quilt of Souls’ author Phyllis Biffle Elmore Feb. 17
item.description: Phyllis Biffle Elmore and radio host Burgin Mathews will discuss Elmore’s memoir, “Quilt of Souls,” in a free program at the Hoover Public Library.

item.title: Alabama Severe Weather Preparedness Sales Tax Holiday set for Feb. 20-22
item.description: Alabama’s annual Severe Weather Preparedness Sales Tax Holiday returns Feb. 20-22, allowing shoppers to purchase qualifying emergency supplies tax free, with expanded exemption limits for 2026.

item.title: Near Me Smoothies & Ice Cream opens in Knox Square development
item.description: Near Me Smoothies & Ice Cream recently opened in Hoover, offering made-to-order smoothies, ice cream and specialty drinks.

item.title: Bucs, Jags advance to regionals
item.description: The Hoover and Spain Park basketball teams will continue playing.

item.title: Jags finish 3rd at state wrestling
item.description: Spain Park High School put forth a strong effort at the state wrestling tournament.

item.title: Southern Voices festival kicks off with artist talk by Christina Renfer Vogel
item.description: Chattanooga-based painter Christina Renfer Vogel will open Hoover Public Library’s annual Southern Voices Festival with a free artist talk and reception on Feb. 19.

item.title: Hoover resident named Alabama French Teacher of the Year
item.description: Hoover resident Allison Harris, a French teacher at the Altamont School, was named the Alabama World Language Association’s 2026 Teacher of the Year.

item.title: Hoover Air Force JROTC program seeks to build leaders
item.description: Hoover High’s AFJROTC program builds leadership and character through competitions, service and hands-on training, producing nationally ranked drill teams and confident student leaders.
